scope: Leviticus 4–27 (809), Numbers 1–36 (1,287), Deuteronomy 1–34 (959), Joshua 1–24 (659), Judges 1–21 (618), Ruth 1–4 (85) 1 Samuel 1–31 (773) 2 Samuel 1–24 (696) and 1 Kings 1–22 (822 plus one attached continuation) authored comparison records; scoped recheck of 233 literary proposals, selected readings, numerical checks and output identity

findings.result: Flock rendering retains the broader option already explicit in 5:6; no global probaton replacement was made.
Paws is supported by the bounded LSJ animal sense citing this passage; literal hands is preserved in the close draft.
Unusual selected-Greek readings were preserved and questions recorded rather than harmonized.
Age ranges, amounts and the stated twenty-obol equivalence were compared to the Greek running text.

The four new candidates were rechecked against exact baseline and authored source comparisons: movement of the camp, selected 2,250, direct-address dost, and adversative But. No general replacement rule was applied.
Selected subgroup totals differ from stated chapter totals by 150 and 500 respectively. These source discrepancies remain explicit; the draft does not change Greek figures to balance arithmetic.
Census and offering arithmetic agrees with the manually compared figures. The repeated offering lists remain in full.
Selected clause placement, ordering, scout names and fuller readings are preserved with explicit unresolved syntax and name decisions.
Exact candidate records rechecked against authored source comparisons: sin in him, sprinkling upon the house, and singular serpent in the petition. No global replacement rule was applied.

Kiln remains an explicit provisional lexical proposal. The recorded LSJ entry includes the competing alcove sense; the consulted scholarly review challenges that sense. Cited papyri and other works were not independently read. This is not settled specialist consensus.

Exact candidates preserve the partitive with some and the selected singular continual offering. The close stage preserves the earlier partitive wording; the following plural their is retained in 29:6.

The census total, repeated festival offering quantities, declining calf sequence, spoil halves and warrior levies agree with the manually read figures. Derived congregation levies are labelled calculations and remain outside the translation.

Selected masculine sin-possessor, longer settlement condition, two itinerary legs, doubled mountain wording, two-thousand-cubit measure and final daughters’ order are preserved. Difficult syntax remains flagged.
Because of you preserves causation without suggesting benefit; fearsome makes the causing-fear sense explicit. Earlier wording is retained in the close drafts.

The eleven generic-livestock proposals were rechecked against their authored Greek comparisons. Specific bovine cattle remains at 7:13, 28:4,18 and the later occurrence in 28:51; no global replacement was used.

The children are the subjects of the selected accusative participles at 11:19. At 18:20 negation belongs to commanded, preserving absent authorization rather than an explicit prohibition. Exact baseline and candidates were rechecked.

Source-led local preposition proposals were checked in their contexts. The difficult outcry/sin connection at 24:15 remains unresolved; the adversarial function of the witness is contextual rather than inserted into en soi at 31:26.
Now and personal emphasis replace an unexpressed behold; both 23:7 objects remain governed by speaking; the selected or and then are restored. The weight/measure idiom remains open.
Selected Syria, visions, second tithe, fuller curse, chapter boundary, healing sins, cleansing hearts, hands and Moses as speaker are retained rather than harmonized.

All 93 units were compared, retaining the full song and blessings, plural burial agency, and selected closing descriptions. Questions include 32:5,27,36,43 and 33:3,7–8,12,16,24. Seventy authored lineations preserve normalized wording; 32:5 retains its compact dash-connected display to avoid changing its exact spacing.

Exact proposals rechecked against authored comparisons and selected Greek constructions: coordination, adversative contrast, future boundary verb, unsupported reflexive beneficiary and negative purpose. At 22:24 the recheck replaced provisional retention with an explicit negative-purpose proposal; supplied It is is identified as English grammar.

Exact candidates retain broader neuter possessions, household-service terminology, singular active agency, explicit Behold, calves and fear without an unsupported object. No general replacement rule was used.
The deliverance sacrificial label remains a consistent provisional choice; salamin at 22:29 remains distinct and unresolved. No completed ritual-specialist review is credited.

Twenty-nine kings were counted in chapter 12. Chapter 15:32 has thirty visible named expressions against printed twenty-nine, and 18:24 has thirteen against twelve; selected totals are not repaired. Chapter 21 groups agree with thirteen plus ten plus thirteen plus twelve equaling forty-eight.

Selected order, lettered additions, Pharaoh/dowry continuation, Judah/Lachish/Lasendak, shorter refuge-city text, stone knives, Shiloh, twelve kings, person shifts and all longer ending material remain. Existing critical-text and antecedent questions are carried forward.

Exact candidates rechecked against the authored source comparisons: presentatives, motion toward Jael, alternative question, adversative, present kinship and explicit Abimelech subject. Existing ambiguous agency and lexical questions remain open.

Exact before/after wording rechecked: emphatic divine-address Thou, future assurance, narrative reply without added if, binding emphasis, action verb, causal link, presentatives, contrast and casualty language. The change at 20:39 removes an explicit killing clause; fatal/nonfatal scope remains open.

Twenty-eight song units and three riddle/boast units have authored lineation with identical normalized wording. Compact dash-linked 5:5 and 5:22 remain unchanged. No human reading-aloud credit is assigned.

Selected thirty-two counts, vow and fulfillment, plural password exchange, future razor clause, barber agency question, Syria/people distinction, Moses genealogy, anger and death statements, unusual ritual syntax, pleasure statement, Lebanon/Lebona and affirmative offence clause remain visible.

Manually checked figures retain 25,000 plus 700 mustered, 22,000 and 18,000 Israelite losses, 25,100 versus 25,000 Benjaminite casualty totals, 18,000 plus 5,000 plus 2,000, and 600 survivors. No source number was altered to remove the 100-person discrepancy.

The complete 85-unit comparison and exact two proposals were rechecked: close Boaz’s blessing before Ruth’s explicit speech and restore the explanatory For. Two authored pledge lineations preserve normalized wording, ordinary human address and the affirmative death clause.

Selected elliptical, hypothetical, agricultural and kinship expressions remain with explicit questions. No harmonization of morning/evening, affirmative maidservant statement, barley meal, go up/went down, feet wording, unspecified six measures, negative matter idiom, field given, plural blessing, your name or Arran/Salman. Ten genealogy names and nine begetting links agree.

All 773 stored units have passage-specific focused comparisons; 58 wording proposals and 715 provisional retentions. The 12 display proposals preserve normalized wording. Every chapter source and exact inherited English was read; chapter 7 used the successful German-interface publisher route. No exhaustive token accounting or independent review is credited.

The expanded song retains wisdom clauses and plural our kings. The 2:33 literary spare/at proposal is distinguished from the negative close draft and inherited every; indefinite scope, surviving identity and altar interpretation remain open. Repeated victory songs use struck consistently, with identical-content lineation.

Human-address inference, coordinate evening/vengeance clause, expanded lot prayer and popular objection, consoled/regretted distinction, hearing the people and divided Israel remain explicit. Broken oath syntax and the 20:12 interrogative-versus-conditional negative are unresolved. The 21:6 causal dia with accusative correction does not settle the obscure road/equipment sense. The affirmative enemy-release conditional is not replaced with a familiar rhetorical denial.

Absent 13:1 and 23:12 remain absent; chapters 17 and 18 retain 32 and 19 stored units. The 30:28a recipient list remains an independent unit. Saul is turned over rather than supplied beheading; Saul and Jonathan are the named recovered bodies, followed by burning and burial in cultivated ground.

Selected ages, reign, military counts, four-cubit giant, helmet penetration, hundred foreskins, Israel loving David, 305 priests, 400 men and four-month stay are retained without harmonization. The later second-year statement remains distinct. The narrator names Samuel without a reception theory. Ahimelech in 30:7 is not normalized to earlier Abimelech. Multi-day pursuit wording and equal spoil shares remain.

All 696 units have authored focused comparisons: 68 wording proposals and 628 provisional retentions. Thirteen new lament lineations and five changed units preserving their inherited poetry breaks were checked against normalized wording. Every chapter Greek, exact inherited text and historical note was read; chapter 20 now has successful fresh source access without rewriting its earlier failed-access history.

Wounded is distinguished from slain where death is not stated. Selected Mephibosheth parentages, Nabal lament, unresolved royal description, doorkeeper and the thirteen-name additional 5:16a list remain. The differing house statements and direct divine/nested human address remain explicit; the incomplete guard-office clause is not filled from a parallel.

Proposals clarify inferred Uriah, plural withdrawal, causal/presentative links and future prediction without changing reported agency. The expanded battle speech, Tamar protest and coercion, David inaction and selected positive divine clauses are preserved. Hushai’s following/behind phrase replaces an unsupported From now on; supplied English predicate and unresolved chosen-person identity are disclosed.

Opaque food terms, recalled-command boundary, pillar taking clauses and hated their hand remain explicitly unresolved. Head rather than supplied hair is caught in the oak. The 19:1 boundary and negative I do not know whether I reign remain. The extended Abel/Dan saying, singular woman execution agency, Michal’s sons, Dan son of Ioa and Elhanan striking Goliath are not harmonized.

Every inherited song line break is preserved, including in five revised poetic units across chapters 22–23. Direct/third-person divine address and selected tense shifts remain. Wounded and inferred foreigners avoid unsupported slain claims. Difficult warrior-list segmentation and total thirty-seven remain unharmonized. Divine incitement, three years, specified census figures, death choice, seventy thousand, meal timing, fifty silver shekels and final Solomon notice remain.

All 822 stored units and the 8:53a attached continuation have authored focused comparisons: 26 wording/punctuation proposals and 796 provisional retentions. All selected chapter Greek, exact inherited English and historical notes were read. The 26 before/after candidates were rechecked against their authored rationales. Retention is provisional and does not credit exhaustive token work.

Expanded chapter 2 (71 units), chapter 12 (54 units), absent 3:1, the combined 11:5–8 unit and other selected gaps remain. The 3:27 inner quotation includes the mother’s full plea. The 8:53a parent and attached continuation retain exact normalized wording in two plus four proposed lines; separate continuation analysis, three drafts and identity checks are recorded.

Selected ages, reigns, dimensions, offerings, workforces, equipment and casualties remain unharmonized: Solomon twelve, 5,000 songs, 440 years, 40×20×25 temple, fourteen-cubit pillar circumference, thirty-three-cubit Sea circumference, 120 talents, differing mare totals, 120,000 militia and 60,000 warriors among them. Rehoboam’s sixteen/twelve and forty-one/seventeen notices remain separate.

Holy objects, rejoicing, the shorter foreigner prayer, plural arrival, seven-day feast and king’s blessing remain. The half-report proposal makes its inferred comparison explicit. The 11:27 builder remains he because 12:24b explicitly makes Jeroboam the builder; that agency was not silently harmonized. Alternative prophetic stories, royal maternal names and difficult cult terminology remain with questions. Elah in 16:9 is a disclosed contextual subject inference.

Elijah’s breathing into the child and the child’s cry, the repeated fire prayers, cloud like a footprint, Ahab’s weeping, divine presence in the breeze and second-person leave seven thousand remain. Naboth precedes the Syrian war. Swine, dogs and prostitutes, false-witness blessed euphemism, the foxes oath, bent/upright proverb, prohibition and ambush reply remain. Micaiah’s repeated opening, lying spirit, my clothing, good aim and lung/rout language are preserved with unresolved questions.

limits: No independent reviewer, exhaustive token alignment, apparatus collation or human read-aloud stage is credited. Retention does not resolve the questions explicitly listed in the passage records.
